text: You have a supercomputer in your pocket.
It tracks the global financial markets in real time.
It connects you to every piece of human knowledge ever recorded.
And yet, somewhere in the back of your mind, there is a quiet, persistent desire to spend
ten, twenty, or fifty thousand dollars on a heavy disc of mechanical steel to
You don't buy a Rolex to tell time.
But you tell yourself it's an investment, an heirloom, a milestone of your success.
